name: Mochizuki
source:
One of the new nurses. She tries her best to do her job, but she is still a clumsy nurse who makes many mistakes because she is still inexperienced.

For this reason, she is often targeted by Numajiri, and is forced to lead a stressful life. She often hangs out with Hiramatsu, who is not  enthusiastic about her work, as if they are kindred spirits.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/sakuseibyoto3/character/index.html]official site[/url]]
